title: Credit Card Fraud Detection
summary: A credit card fraud detection pipeline using XGBoost, SHAP, and a Streamlit demo app for interactive simulation of transactions. An archived notebook uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer to generate synthetic fraud-class transactions for class imbalance mitigation.
